confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not based on live listings or booking pages. Melbourne is the primary comparable (same country and currency, similar price level). Sydney is set near parity for beer, coffee and inexpensive meals and somewhat higher for mid-range dining and accommodation. Accommodation is least certain given July seasonality, events and rate variance. Cocktail and wine are cross-checked against beer (about 1.75 times and 1.1 times beer) because direct knowledge is only moderate. The RBA rate was read from search excerpts of the RBA exchange-rates page, corroborated by a second search but not opened directly; it postdates the July window and served only as a level check.
comparable_city_reasoning: Melbourne, Australia is the primary comparable (same country and currency, similar price level). Sydney is near Melbourne for beer, coffee and inexpensive meals, modestly higher for mid-range dining and hotels, and highest relative to Melbourne for hostel beds. Krakow and Kathmandu were not used as direct comparables.
